description: Due colonne di paragrafi sotto due titoli: l'ordine di lettura deve essere colonna sinistra, poi colonna destra.

blocks.text: Place the harbor tile in the centre of the table and give every player one lantern token and three coin tokens.
Shuffle the ferry cards and deal two to each player; keep them hidden until the first tide phase begins.
The youngest player takes the starting buoy and chooses which side of the harbor will receive the first cargo.
During the tide phase each player reveals one ferry card and moves their lantern along the matching canal.
A lantern that reaches a lighthouse space scores two points and returns to the harbor on the next turn.
The game ends when the last cargo crate leaves the dock; the player with the most points wins.
